HM-BRIDGE.menu-hint: Connection status, reachability test, and search-index rebuild.
HM-BRIDGE.manager-url-hint: One or more Homebrew Manager URLs, comma-separated. The default covers both the desktop app (http://localhost:5051) and the dev server (http://localhost:5173); this world connects to every one that is running. The manager never calls Foundry. If a manager refuses this world, click Allow next to the Foundry badge on its Files page.
HM-BRIDGE.bridge-token-hint: Optional shared secret when your Homebrew Manager is configured with HBM_BRIDGE_TOKEN.
HM-BRIDGE.auto-connect-hint: Open the bridge as soon as the world is ready. Turn off to connect manually from Bridge Status.
HM-BRIDGE.include-world-hint: Include this world's own Items directory alongside compendiums.
HM-BRIDGE.exclude-packs-hint: Comma-separated pack ids or prefixes to skip, e.g. dnd5e., dnd-players-handbook. Leave empty to search everything.
HM-BRIDGE.fuzzy-hint: When no exact name matches, fall back to similarity matching so typos and word-order differences are still found. Fuzzy hits are flagged in the report rather than treated as confirmed.
HM-BRIDGE.fuzzy-threshold-hint: Minimum similarity for a fuzzy match. Higher is stricter. Default 0.72.
HM-BRIDGE.max-matches-hint: How many Foundry documents to report per homebrew entry. Useful when the same item exists in several compendiums.
HM-BRIDGE.enforce-hint: When anyone adds an item the Homebrew Manager maps to a replacement, add the replacement instead and post a chat message the sheet's owner or a GM can confirm or override. The mappings come from the manager each time this world connects to it.
HM-BRIDGE.banner-hint: Show players a banner on the sheet of an item that has a replacement.
HM-BRIDGE.verbose-hint: Post a notification each time the manager runs a check. Useful while setting things up.
HM-BRIDGE.status-hint: The manager's "Check Foundry" button works while any manager below shows Connected. Rebuild the index after importing or bulk-editing a compendium.
HM-BRIDGE.err-no-url: Set at least one Homebrew Manager URL in module settings.
HM-BRIDGE.err-stream-closed: The manager closed the connection. Retrying…
HM-BRIDGE.err-offline: Nothing is listening at this address. Retrying in the background.
HM-BRIDGE.refused-toast: The Homebrew Manager at {url} refused this world. In the manager, click Allow next to the Foundry badge on the Files page, or add {origin} under Settings → Foundry URL. It will connect on its own within a few seconds.
HM-BRIDGE.sent-to: Added {n} from the site browser to {name}.
HM-BRIDGE.err-no-neptunium: Sending to a chosen actor needs Neptunium active in this world.
HM-BRIDGE.err-no-doc: Nothing in this world has the id {uuid}. It may have been deleted since the check.
HM-BRIDGE.err-no-replacement: The replacement "{name}" isn't in this world's Items or compendiums.
HM-BRIDGE.err-ambiguous-replacement: Several documents are named "{name}" and none is clearly {source}.
HM-BRIDGE.err-replacement-type: the replacement "{name}" is a {type}, and an item can't change type as it's added
HM-BRIDGE.err-not-on-actor: That item isn't on an actor's sheet.
HM-BRIDGE.swap-failed: Couldn't swap {item} for its replacement ({error}). It was added as-is.
HM-BRIDGE.chat-replaced: {actor} tried to import {item} but it was replaced with {replacement}.
HM-BRIDGE.banner-replaced: {item} is replaced by {replacement} in your world.
HM-BRIDGE.banner-attempted: {item} was replaced by {replacement} when you tried to add it. It is replaced in your world.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-menu-hint: Look through every character sheet for items the Homebrew Manager maps to a replacement, preview them, and swap the ones you choose.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-summary: {items} items to replace on {characters} characters. {replaced} already replaced.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-hint: Click a name to open it. Where several documents could replace an item, pick one; the one matching the mapping's source is chosen for you.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-none: No character has anything to replace.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-no-rules: This world holds no mappings yet. The Homebrew Manager sends them when the world connects to it.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-pick-one: Several documents match and none is clearly from the mapping's source. Pick one.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-dropped: {n} activity pins or favorites had no match and were removed.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-summary-refs: {n} more are only referenced, by a class, feature or link.
HM-BRIDGE.scan-not-on-sheet: Not on the sheet, only referenced.
HM-BRIDGE.blocklist-updated: The Homebrew Manager updated Neptunium's World Content Blocklist ({n} rules). Connected players may need to reload.
HM-BRIDGE.err-blocklist-no-neptunium: Neptunium isn't active in this world, so there's no World Content Blocklist to update.
HM-BRIDGE.err-blocklist-not-gm: Only a GM can change the World Content Blocklist.
HM-BRIDGE.err-neptunium-not-gm: Only a GM can change Neptunium's settings.
HM-BRIDGE.err-neptunium-no-config: This Neptunium version has no config setting where the bridge expects one (plutonium.config).
HM-BRIDGE.neptunium-changed: The Homebrew Manager set these Neptunium settings for this world:
HM-BRIDGE.neptunium-reload-hint: Neptunium only reads its settings when the page loads. Reload before changing any Neptunium setting, or that change will put the old values back. Connected players need to reload too.
HM-BRIDGE.err-blocklist-no-setting: This Neptunium version has no World Content Blocklist setting where the bridge expects one (plutonium.blacklist).
